description: porti_strutture_per_navigazione_point is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. Portolano web è il navigatore geografico con cui individuare le strutture portuali e di approdo presenti sulle idrovie e sui principali laghi della Lombardia. Per quanto attiene ai laghi attraverso l'applicazione è possibile consultare le principali regole o limiti alla navigazione. L'utente può scaricare i dati relativi ai livelli informativi: porti regole di navigazione. Coverage: Regione Lombardia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Lombardia. Its tags are acqua, acque, adda, approdi, approdo. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, RDF, TSV, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
